components.name: Chicken Marinade
steps: Mix everything really well
cover and let it marinate in the fridge for a couple of minutes

components.name: For the Rice
steps: heat up a large pot
add the chicken and sear until the chicken is nicely browned and fully cooked
take the chicken out
add butter to the pan
Add some chopped onions, minced garlic and ginger, then cook for about one to two minutes until the onions are softened
Add tomato paste, cook for a couple of minutes until it darkens slightly
Keep stirring
add the tomato puree
Give it a good mix
season with some paprika, cayenne pepper, curry powder, cumin, chicken bouillon cubes, garam masala, salt, and a little sugar
added some chicken stock and water
let this simmer for about 15 minutes
add heavy cream, then give it a very good mix until it's smooth and creamy
add the rice
rinsed the rice several times until the water ran clear
mix everything together, then cover and allow to cook on low heat for about 30 minutes until the rice is fully cooked
stir it very well to allow some of the steam escape
add the chicken back in
Give everything one final mix
finish with some chopped cilantro or parsley
